generated_for: Surfboards by Todd Pinder official named model catalog

brands.name: Surfboards by Todd Pinder
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped and hand-glassed surfboards by Todd Pinder in Honolulu, Hawaii.

models.name: Standard
models.description:
A versatile all-around longboard designed to perform equally well off the tail and on the nose. 
 [Recommended Size] 
8'0-11'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers looking for a true all-around longboard
・Riders who want versatility across different conditions
・A great everyday choice for a wide range of styles and skill levels
 [Design & Feel]
 The Standard is built to balance stability and maneuverability.
A roll-to-vee bottom helps smooth rail-to-rail transitions while adding control and responsiveness.
Typical tail options include round pin or squash, depending on the rider’s preference and intended feel.
The board is most commonly set up as a 2+1, but also works well as a single fin or quad depending on conditions.
 [Performance] 
Reliable, adaptable, and easy to ride — a go-to longboard that covers everything from trimming to turning.

models.name: Ala Bing
models.description:
A versatile all-around longboard designed for both nose riding and smooth performance off the tail. 
 [Recommended Size] 
9'3-10'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers looking for a true everyday longboard
・Works well in a wide range of conditions
・Ideal for riders who want balance between classic style and performance
 [Design & Feel]
 Inspired by an early Bing from Joel Tudor’s collection, but refined with a modern perspective.
The outline features a subtle bump in the tail, giving it a clean, flowing curve reminiscent of classic Noosa and old Keyo-style Australian mals.
 The bottom features:
・Slightly dished concave (nothing too aggressive)
・Gentle roll for smooth transitions
・Nice tail lift for responsiveness
・Straight entry for clean glide and speed
 [Shaper’s Note] 
“I wanted to build a really good all-around log that performs off the tail while still holding the nose.”

models.name: High Too
models.description:
A stable, high-performance noserider with excellent turning ability and classic flow. 
 [Recommended Size] 
9'4-10'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers looking for a dedicated noserider
・Riders who want stability without sacrificing turning performance
・Ideal for smooth, stylish longboarding
 [Design & Feel] 
Inspired by the classic G&S Mike Hansen HYII model, this board blends traditional noserider elements with modern refinements.
The outline keeps the full, stable feel of the HYII, while the nose is influenced by the Newhiwa model for added versatility. The signature hip remains, helping the board turn surprisingly well for a noserider.
 Key design features include:
 ・Deep concave for strong nose hold
・Side panels for added stability and control
・Tail lift with slightly more kick for responsiveness
・Pretty flat entry with a touch of nose flip
 The deck is kept extremely flat — about 3 inches off the stringer on both sides — creating a platform-like feel with no dome.
 [Shaper’s Note] 
Built using Joel Tudor’s Springfield rocker — his go-to noserider rocker — for reliable nose riding and smooth glide.

models.name: So Square
models.description:
The quintessential classic noserider — built for stability, smooth trimming, and confident nose riding. 
 [Recommended Size] 
9'4-10'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers looking for a true traditional noserider
・Riders who prioritize stability and classic flow
・Ideal for smooth trimming and extended nose rides
 [Design & Feel] 
The So Square features a full classic outline, rolled bottom, and a well-defined nose concave — all working together to maximize stability while riding the nose.
This design has been refined over many years to create a balanced longboard that trims beautifully on the nose while maintaining smooth, controlled transitions from the tail.
 [Performance] 
Stable, predictable, and timeless — a true classic noserider experience.

models.name: Straight Pin
models.description:
A smoother, more flowing variation of the So Square, designed with a pin tail for cleaner transitions through turns. 
 [Recommended Size] 
9'4-10'0
 (Typically ordered 1–2" longer than the So Square.)
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers who like the stability of the So Square but want smoother turning
・Riders looking for a more flowing, drawn-out feel through transitions
・Ideal for classic longboarding with added control
 [Design & Feel] 
The Straight Pin takes the proven design foundation of the So Square and adds a pin tail to create smoother rail-to-rail transitions and a more fluid turning feel.
 [Performance] 
Stable on the nose like the So Square, but with a more refined, flowing response through turns.

models.name: Newhiwa
models.description:
A classic-inspired longboard with modern refinements for easier performance and everyday usability. 
 [Recommended Size] 
9'0-10'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers who love the feel of classic longboards but want more ease of use
・Riders looking for a balance between traditional glide and modern performance
・Great as an everyday longboard for a wide range of surfers
 [Design & Feel] 
The Newhiwa starts with the foundation of a classic Nuuhiwa-style noserider, then introduces subtle modern adjustments to improve usability and performance.
 Key design refinements include:
 ・Updated rocker for smoother turning and control
・Refined rails for easier handling
・Balanced foil for improved responsiveness
 Compared to traditional logs with heavier roll bottoms and 50/50 rails, the Newhiwa feels more user-friendly while still maintaining classic longboard character.
 [Performance] 
A smooth, classic feel with added maneuverability — designed to make traditional longboarding more accessible without losing its soul.

models.name: Keyo
models.description:
An Aussie mal–inspired longboard with pig-like characteristics, blending tail performance with smooth noseriding control. 
 [Recommended Size] 
9'4-10'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers who like classic Australian mal style with added versatility
・Riders who want strong tail performance without losing noseriding ability
・Ideal for smooth, flowing longboard surfing with control in the pocket
 [Design & Feel] 
The template was taken from a 9'10" Keyo that Joel Tudor picked up at the Noosa Surf Festival in the late ’90s. Inspired by classic Aussie mals, the design carries pig-like influences without being a true pig.
 
Wide hips and a nicely blended concave create smooth flow and control, while the slightly narrower nose helps the board lock into the pocket during noseriding.
 [Performance] 
Performs beautifully off the tail while maintaining secure, controlled noseriding — a balanced blend of Australian classic style and functional performance.

models.name: RNR
models.description:
A classic log-style noserider designed for traditional longboarding, combining strong noseriding stability with a slightly more responsive outline. 
 [Recommended Size]
 9'4-10"2 
[Who Is This Board For?]
 ・Surfers who want a true classic noserider
・Riders who enjoy traditional cross-stepping and extended nose rides
・Longboarders looking for a stable log with a slightly looser outline
・Anyone who appreciates classic late-60s style longboard design 
[Design & Feel]
 The RNR is built around a very traditional log concept. It features a heavy rolled bottom, classic 50/50 rails, and a deep blended nose concave designed to maximize lift while riding the nose.
 While inspired by classic Nuuhiwa-style boards, the RNR has a slightly more pulled-in nose and a bit more hip in the tail. This adds more curve to the outline and reduces the parallel feel often found in traditional noseriders, giving the board a smoother, more responsive character while still maintaining excellent stability on the nose.
 [Performance]
 The combination of the rolled bottom, deep nose concave, and 50/50 rails creates a board that excels at traditional longboarding. The RNR offers strong hold and lift for noseriding, while the added curve in the outline helps loosen the board up when turning from the tail.
 The result is a classic log that feels smooth, stable, and predictable, yet slightly more maneuverable than many traditional parallel-outline noseriders.

models.name: Neo
models.description:
A modern noserider designed to blend classic stability with more responsive performance. 
 [Recommended Size] 
9'0-9'7
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers who want a modern take on a noserider
・Riders looking for more responsiveness off the tail
・Great for chest-high to slightly overhead surf
 [Design & Feel]
 This is Joel Tudor’s interpretation of the modern noserider — based on the Nuuhiwa noserider but updated with design refinements developed over the last 40 years.
The outline keeps a full nose and tail for stability, while subtle modern adjustments make the board more reactive and versatile.
 Key design features:
 ・Less roll in the bottom than traditional logs
・60/40 rails for added bite and control
・Softly dished concave (not overly defined)
・Balanced rocker with smooth entry
・Tail lift for responsiveness, but less than classic logs
 The biggest difference is near the tail block, where a subtle edge in the last few inches gives clear feedback when stepping on the tail.
 [Performance] 
Stable for noseriding, but noticeably more responsive off the tail — making it a true modern crossover longboard.

models.name: PNR
models.description:
A fast, maneuverable longboard that blends 2+1 performance with added stability for trimming and noseriding. 
 [Recommended Size] 
8'6-10'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers who like the speed and responsiveness of a 2+1 setup
・Riders wanting extra width for smoother trimming
・Those looking for added stability while still enjoying nose riding
 [Design & Feel] 
The PNR combines performance-oriented speed and maneuverability with a slightly wider platform to improve balance and control on the nose.
 [Performance] 
Quick and responsive off the tail, yet stable enough for confident trimming and noseriding — making it a versatile option for surfers who want performance without sacrificing flow.

models.name: Three's
models.description:
An original speed shape designed for faster down-the-line performance without sacrificing control. 
 [Recommended Size] 
8'6-10'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers looking for speed and drive
・Riders who want a more performance-oriented longboard feel
・Great when the surf has more energy and push
 [Design & Feel] 
This model was designed as Joel’s original speed shape.
Instead of the roll-to-vee bottom found on models like the Standard and So Pro, the Three’s uses a straighter vee bottom paired with slightly softer rails. This combination increases speed while maintaining control.
 Round pin or diamond tails are typically used for this design, depending on the desired feel.
 [Performance] 
Fast, smooth, and responsive — built for surfers who want more speed while keeping classic longboard flow.

models.name: POPE
models.description:
A fast, clean-trimming performance log inspired by late-60s longboard design. 
 [Recommended Size] 
9'0-10'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers who prefer smooth trimming and speed over traditional noseriding
・Riders looking for a performance-oriented log
・Ideal for head-high to overhead waves
 [Design & Feel] 
Originally shaped in 2018 for Tosh Tudor, the POPE was inspired by a classic Phil Edwards Honolulu model from the late 60s–early 70s — an era focused on creating the most performance-driven longboards of the time.
The design avoids heavy nose concave, allowing for clean, uninterrupted trimming with no hang-ups. The rocker is slightly relaxed, and an extra half-inch of width adds versatility for a wider range of conditions.
Because it doesn’t rely on a wide noserider-style outline, some surfers also ride the POPE as a glider or speed shape.
 [Performance] 
Fast, flowing, and smooth — built for surfers who want glide and performance rather than traditional noseriding.

models.name: Z-Pig
models.description:
A classic pig-style longboard inspired by one of the earliest performance designs in longboard history. 
 [Recommended Size] 
9'4-10'4
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers who appreciate classic longboard design with strong turning ability
・Riders who like surfing from the tail but still want noseriding capability
・Ideal for traditional style with added maneuverability
 [Design & Feel] 
The classic pig shape features wide hips with the wide point set further back, allowing easy turning and control from the tail.
At the same time, the narrower nose fits naturally into the critical part of the wave, giving the board solid noseriding potential despite its performance-oriented outline.
 [Performance] 
Smooth, pivoty turns from the tail with surprising nose control — a timeless blend of classic style and early performance thinking.

models.name: Zeppelin
models.description:
A versatile all-around glider inspired by classic Hawaiian big-board designs. 
 [Recommended Size] 
10'0-12'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
Surfers looking for smooth glide and effortless trim
Riders who enjoy drawn-out lines and relaxed surfing
Ideal for those wanting classic big-board flow with modern usability
 [Design & Feel] 
Inspired by Skip Frye’s Eagle — itself influenced by the early big boards ridden by Tom Blake and Duke in Waikiki — the Zeppelin brings classic glider concepts into a more everyday, all-around design.
 Drawing from Joel’s experience shaping large boards with Cippy, the template adds more curve to loosen up the feel, allowing forgiving turns while maintaining glide and control.
 A balanced rocker keeps the board smooth and easy to ride across a variety of conditions.
 [Performance] 
Effortless speed, smooth trimming, and forgiving turns — a modern glider with strong Hawaiian roots.

models.name: Herb
models.description:
A versatile midlength egg designed as a true one-board quiver. 
 [Recommended Size] 
7'7-8'3
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers looking for a single board that works across many conditions
・Riders who want easy glide without stepping into full longboard territory
・Great for those who enjoy relaxed, all-around surfing
 [Design & Feel] 
Originally sourced by Joel Tudor, this design traces back to a Herbie Fletcher model shaped by Steve Kroll. The Herb keeps the smooth, playful feel of a classic egg while adding enough length to increase glide and versatility.
At around 7'10, it sits right between a midlength and longboard feel — long enough for cheater fives, but still compact and maneuverable.
 [Performance] 
Handles a wide range of conditions — from waist-high mushy beach breaks to overhead reef waves — making it a true utility board for surfers who want one board that can do it all.

models.name: Mid Pin
models.description:
A versatile mid length designed to handle a wide range of waves and conditions. 
 [Recommended Size] 
7'2-7'10
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers looking for a dependable everyday midlength
・Riders surfing both small beach breaks and more powerful waves
・Those who want flexibility in fin setup and riding style
 [Design & Feel] 
The Mid Pin balances glide, control, and responsiveness, making it an easy board to trust in many different conditions — from softer beach breaks to overhead points and reefs.
 [Performance] 
Typically ridden as a single fin for smooth flow and trim, but also works well as a quad when more drive and speed are desired.

models.name: Fryed Egg
models.description:
A classic-inspired midlength egg that blends smooth glide with early shortboard-era performance. 
 [Recommended Size] 
7'2-7'8
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers looking for the smooth, flowing feel of a true egg
・Riders who enjoy glide, trim, and clean rail engagement
・Ideal for those wanting classic design with modern usability
 [Design & Feel] 
Inspired by a 7'6" G&S Skip Frye from the late 1960s transition era — one of the early shortboard revolution designs — the Fryed Egg takes the original outline and refines it for a more versatile modern feel.
 While the original board leaned heavily toward a hull-style design with extreme roll, this version reduces the roll for improved usability while keeping the classic character.
 Bottom shape:
・Flat entry
・Rolled mid-section
・Flat off the tail
 Features include:
・Down rails with a 60/40 feel
・Slight edge in the tail for control and release
 [Performance] 
Smooth, flowing, and balanced — the Fryed Egg captures the essence of a true egg while offering a more accessible modern ride.

models.name: Tri Plane Egg
models.description:
A stretched-out evolution of the Fryed Egg, designed for more glide, longer rail engagement, and smoother speed through turns. 
 [Recommended Size] 
7'5-8'3
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers who want more glide and flow from an egg design
・Riders who prefer longer, drawn-out lines
・Ideal for those looking for smooth speed rather than quick, snappy turns
 [Design & Feel] 
Starting with the foundation of the classic Fryed Egg, this design extends the outline to create a longer rail line and increased glide.
A tri-plane bottom was added to help the board carry speed through turns while maintaining smooth rail transitions and control.
 [Performance] 
Fast and flowing with excellent carry through turns — built for surfers who want effortless momentum and longer lines.

models.name: Modern Machine
models.description:
A high-performance egg designed for surfers who want speed, flow, and tighter turning response. 
 [Recommended Size] 
6'9-7'5
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
Surfers who like the feel of an egg but want more performance
Riders looking for quicker turning and responsiveness
Great for those wanting a modern approach to a classic midlength concept
 [Design & Feel] 
Inspired by G&S and Joel Tudor’s modern interpretations of the egg, the Modern Machine blends classic width and glide with performance-focused refinements.
A wide squash tail and flatter rocker create speed and drive, while a subtle vee — slight through the center, deeper near the fins, and flattening off the tail — helps the board transition smoothly from rail to rail.
A touch more tail rocker has been added to loosen the feel and improve turning response.
 [Performance] 
Fast, responsive, and easy to turn — ideal for surfers who want an egg that feels lively and performance-oriented.

models.name: Hull
models.description:
A classic hull design built for speed, glide, and long drawn-out lines. 
 [Recommended Size] 
7'0-9'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
Surfers who love smooth carving and flowing lines
Riders looking for speed generated through trim and rail engagement
Ideal for clean, open-faced waves
 [Design & Feel] 
Built around a traditional hull bottom, this design emphasizes effortless speed and smooth transitions through long, drawn-out turns.
The rails are slightly tapered through the wave face, helping the board hold and carve cleanly while maintaining flow.
 [Performance] 
Best suited for long-walled reef and point breaks where the board can run and draw continuous lines.

models.name: Winter Egg
models.description:
A step-up egg designed for overhead to well-overhead surf, built for control and confidence in powerful waves. 
 [Recommended Size] 
7'6-8'6
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers looking for an egg that handles serious surf
・Riders wanting earlier entry and added confidence in bigger waves
・Ideal as a step-up midlength for powerful conditions
 [Design & Feel] 
Building on the legacy of the original Modern Machine by G&S, the Winter Egg adds length and volume to improve paddle power and early wave entry.
A pulled-in tail provides control through bottom turns and stability in the tube, while an accelerated entry rocker helps manage late, critical drops.
 [Performance] 
Fast, confident, and controlled in larger surf — designed to hold its line when conditions get serious.

models.name: Small Hawk
models.description:
A compact twin fin that brings the glide and paddle power of the Modern Machine into a shorter, more playful package. 
 [Recommended Size] 
6'4-7'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers looking for a shorter alternative to a traditional midlength
・Riders who want easy paddling with added speed and maneuverability
・Anyone seeking a versatile everyday twin fin with classic flow and modern responsiveness
 [Design & Feel]
 The Small Hawk takes the familiar entry and flow of the Modern Machine and pairs it with a Sam Hawk–inspired winged round pin tail. Positioned higher than a traditional wing, the wing allows the outline to maintain a generous wide point while drawing into a refined pin tail, creating a natural pivot point for smooth, controlled turns.
 A flatter deck, fuller rails, and a simple vee bottom preserve the classic egg-inspired feel, delivering excellent paddle power, early wave entry, and effortless trim.
 [Performance] 
Fast, loose, and incredibly easy to surf, the Small Hawk combines the glide of a midlength with the responsiveness of a compact twin fin. It carries speed naturally while remaining smooth on rail, making bottom turns and top turns feel intuitive and fluid. The result is a playful, high-performance board that never sacrifices the easy ride and flow of its bigger siblings.

models.name: Wing Twin
models.description:
A modern egg-inspired twin fin that combines easy paddling, smooth glide, and fast, responsive performance. 
 [Recommended Size] 
6'3-7'9
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers who love the glide of an egg but want a more modern feel
・Riders looking for more speed and maneuverability than a traditional single fin
・An everyday board that balances easy wave-catching with responsive performance
 [Design & Feel]
 The Wing Twin features the generous planing area and trim of a classic egg, but with a more refined outline, pulled-in shoulders, and tapered down rails. A subtle spiral vee through the tail loosens up the board while maintaining smooth rail-to-rail transitions, creating a fast yet controlled feel underfoot.
 [Performance] 
The twin fin setup delivers plenty of speed and a loose, lively feel, while the egg-inspired outline provides excellent paddle power and glide. A great choice for surfers who want modern performance without giving up the easy, flowing characteristics of a classic midlength.

models.name: Single Fin
models.description:
A classic single fin concept refined with subtle modern updates for added speed and control. 
 [Recommended Size] 
5'8-6'8
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers who appreciate traditional single fin flow
・Riders looking for smooth, drawn-out turns and clean lines
・Ideal for those wanting classic style with improved usability
 [Design & Feel] 
Like many of Joel Tudor’s designs, this model looks back at where classic shapes left off and takes the next step forward.
The original single fin outline is preserved, while subtle refinements to the foil and rocker add speed, control, and overall versatility without losing the timeless single fin character.
 [Performance] 
Smooth, flowing, and stylish — maintaining the classic single fin feel while offering a more modern level of control.

models.name: Simmons
models.description:
A modern planing hull inspired by the original mini Simmons, built for speed and effortless glide in small, weak surf. 
 [Recommended Size] 
5'0-5'6
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
Surfers looking for maximum speed in small or weak waves
Riders who enjoy glide and easy planing feel
Ideal for fun, everyday surf where traditional shortboards struggle
 [Design & Feel] 
Inspired by the classic mini Simmons, this modern interpretation combines a short length with a wide outline to generate speed with minimal effort.
A rolled entry and soft rails create forgiving, smooth turns while maintaining the fast, skatey feel that makes this design so fun.
 [Performance] 
Fast and easy to ride even in tiny surf.
Twin keels emphasize classic speed and flow, while a quad setup adds extra drive and control when needed.

models.name: Mod-tro Fish
models.description:
A modern take on the classic fish, blending retro speed with improved maneuverability. 
 [Recommended Size] 
5'0-6'0
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
Surfers who love the speed and glide of a traditional fish
Riders wanting a fish that feels more responsive and easier to turn
Ideal for fun, fast surfing without losing control
 [Design & Feel] 
Inspired by classic Lis and Frye fish designs, the Mod-tro Fish adds slightly more curve to both the outline and rocker to increase responsiveness and versatility.
A well-balanced single-to-double concave bottom helps maintain speed while allowing smoother transitions and improved maneuverability.
 [Performance] 
Fast and playful like a classic fish, but with a more modern turning feel and added control.

models.name: Mix
models.description:
A versatile shortboard that blends elements from multiple designs into one adaptable shape. 
 [Recommended Size] 
5'3-6'3
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
Surfers looking for one board that can do a bit of everything
Riders who want flexibility in feel and fin setup
Ideal for those who like experimenting across different conditions
 [Design & Feel] 
The Mix combines key elements from Joel’s other models into a single, balanced design. A retro-inspired outline is paired with modern foils and bottom contours, creating a board that feels familiar yet progressive.
Designed to be adaptable, the Mix supports a variety of fin setups depending on conditions and riding style.
 [Performance] 
Think of it as the “Swiss Army Knife” of the lineup — versatile, reliable, and ready for a wide range of waves and approaches.

models.name: Cosmic Twin
models.description:
A fast, versatile twin fin built for easy speed, smooth flow, and controlled release across a wide range of conditions. 
 [Recommended Size] 
5'4-5'10
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
Surfers looking for a balanced twin fin that works in many conditions
Riders who want easy speed with controlled release
Ideal for beach and reef breaks from waist-high to overhead surf
 [Design & Feel] 
The Cosmic Twin combines a snub nose with a smooth mid-outline to create effortless speed and flow. The outline straightens through the fin area into a swallow tail, adding control while maintaining a lively, free-feeling release.
A low entry rocker keeps paddling easy and speed high, while a touch of tail rocker adds responsiveness and keeps the board feeling active underfoot. The bottom runs flat up front, transitioning into a single concave through the last two-thirds, finishing with a subtle double between the fins to enhance drive and hold.
 [Performance] 
Fast and flowing with a controlled twin-fin feel — designed to stay lively while maintaining confidence in a wide range of waves.

models.name: 3M
models.description:
A concept twin fin built for speed, looseness, and playful performance in everyday waves. 
 [Recommended Size] 
5'4-6'4
 [Who Is This Board For?] 
・Surfers looking for a fast, loose twin-fin feel
・Riders who enjoy playful performance in fun conditions
・Ideal for waist-high to slightly overhead surf
 [Design & Feel] 
Designed in collaboration with Eli Mirandon in San Diego, the 3M (Mirandon Mind Machine) takes inspiration from the sweet spot of an early-2000s 6'5" Xanadu step-up.
The combination of a super low entry rocker and extreme tail rocker creates a unique balance of speed and maneuverability.
A single-to-double concave bottom helps generate drive and keeps the board fast and lively underfoot.
 [Performance] 
Ultra-fast and loose, the 3M is designed to make everyday waves feel fun, responsive, and energetic.
